title: Spec 014 Mounted Tenant Storage Route and Root OpenAPI Parity

phases.objective: Document only the one Tenant Storage route that is actually mounted in the runtime, compose it into the root OpenAPI through the precise sole-writer path, and keep the 18 specification-only Hostinger design routes out of the runtime contract.

e2e_journeys.actor: Tenant user with a signed user JWT
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact mounted fail-closed route is represented once in the root OpenAPI through a precise fragment reference, while specification-only admin and tenant design routes remain unmounted and absent from the root runtime contract.
steps: Read the mounted Express route and prove it requires a signed non-admin tenant user JWT.
Prove the route accepts only operation_id and expected_sha and rejects unowned or extra request fields.
Prove the route requires an immutable synthetic-only runtime with provider dispatch and Production readiness disabled.
Register the exact POST signature in a deterministic feature registry fragment.
Request generated output through the read-only exact-head refresh bridge and the registered sole writer; do not edit the root OpenAPI manually.
Compose the registered path into the root OpenAPI through the precise contract sync writer.
Verify the root path is one external path-item ref to the Hostinger tenant runtime fragment.
Verify the OpenAPI operation uses userJwtAuth, is consequential, and exposes bounded secret-free request and response schemas.
Verify the 18 specification-only /admin/hosting/storage and /me/hosting/storage design routes are not added to the runtime OpenAPI.
Run precise registry check mode and require zero missing paths and zero conflicts.
assertions: The root OpenAPI contains POST /tenant/storage-operations/apply-plan through the exact registered fragment ref.
The runtime source is routes/hostingerStorageTenantRoutes.js and the auth profile is user_jwt.
Only the mounted route is documented; specification-only Hostinger design surfaces remain absent.
Registry fragments are loaded deterministically and duplicate signatures fail closed.
The generated root update is produced by the governed sole writer from an exact-head read-only request and not by a manual root-file edit.
No provider call, runtime mount, live database access, migration, deployment, main merge, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Mount the separately authorized real tenant storage runtime only after live schema, signer, migration, and dependency-injection gates are satisfied.
Preserve exact route/OpenAPI parity across generated-artifact refreshes and registry-fragment growth.
This repository contract repair performs no live canary.
This change grants no deployment, main, or Production authority.
